description: Na₂WTe₄O₁₂ crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/c space group. Na is bonded in a 7-coordinate geometry to seven O atoms. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.34-2.74 Å. W is bonded to six O atoms to form distorted WO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent TeO₅ square pyramids. There are a spread of W-O bond distances ranging from 1.82-2.14 Å. There are two inequivalent Te sites. In the first Te site, Te is bonded in a distorted see-saw-like geometry to four O atoms. There are a spread of Te-O bond distances ranging from 1.88-2.56 Å. In the second Te site, Te is bonded to five O atoms to form distorted TeO₅ square pyramids that share  a cornercorner with one WO₆ octahedra and  an edgeedge with one TeO₅ square pyramid. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 52°. There are a spread of Te-O bond distances ranging from 1.90-2.37 Å. There are six inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent Te atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to two equivalent Na and two Te atoms. In the third O site, O is bonded to two equivalent Na and two Te atoms to form distorted corner-sharing ONa₂Te₂ trigonal pyramids. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one W and one Te atom. In the fifth O site, O is bonded in a distorted bent 150 degrees geometry to one W and one Te atom. In the sixth O site, O is bonded in a trigonal planar geometry to one Na, one W, and one Te atom.
